integrity: The general statement is proved symbolically. Computational checks are explicitly limited to small finite instances and are not used as exhaustive evidence for the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated only for at least three levels, each of size at least two.
It classifies homotopy components of self-maps but not the internal homotopy type of the null component.
Finite enumerations are supplementary checks and not a proof of the infinite parameter statement.
title: Self-homotopy classification of finite weak orders with at least three levels
